account.description: The account, as get_orders takes it, such as an order's account_hash; needed only when the login shares several accounts.

include_raw.description: Also return Schwab's JSON of the order, with account numbers masked, the tag shown only as its origin, and a value of a key the server does not know withheld unless it is a time, a code, a number that cannot be an account number, or a number already masked.
